sloka: ततस्त्विन्द्रजिता लङ्का सूर्यप्रतिमतेजसा।रराजा प्रतिवीरेण द्यौरिवार्केण भास्वता ।। ६.७३.१५ ।।
transliteration: tatastvindrajitā laṅkā sūryapratimatejasā।rarājā prativīreṇa dyaurivārkeṇa bhāsvatā ।। 6.73.15 ।।

translations.english: He, the destroyer of foes went with white parasols like a full moon shine in the sky.
